title: Unary halting language has polynomial layered circuits
statement: Let $H$ be the set of natural numbers $m$ for which the machine with index given by the first component of the Cantor pairing decomposition of $m$ halts on input given by its second component. The language of all-true Boolean lists whose lengths belong to $H$ is recognized by a family of layered circuits over Boolean values, with every layer finite and using only identity, NOT, and unbounded-fan-in AND gates. There are natural numbers $a$ and $k$ such that, for every input length $n$, the number of noninput circuit nodes is at most $a(n+1)^k$.
